question: Should the Copilot bridge preserve SDK-valid omitted parameters, or intentionally require every bridged Copilot tool to provide an object parameters schema?
rationale: The submitted stricter gate changes which existing Copilot bridged tools survive startup, so accepting that behavior would be an explicit compatibility decision rather than a routine bug fix.

options.title: Preserve SDK-compatible no-parameter tools
options.body: Keep omitted parameters valid, normalize them only when needed, and add focused regression coverage before merge.

options.title: Approve a stricter bridge contract
options.body: Require object parameters for every Copilot bridged tool and document the upgrade impact for existing descriptors.

options.title: Re-cut a smaller current-main slice
options.body: Close or pause the stale draft and open a fresh Copilot-only PR against the current tool-surface runtime.

recommendation.title: Preserve SDK-compatible no-parameter tools
recommendation.body: Keep omitted parameters valid, normalize them only when needed, and add focused regression coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the most recent current-main Copilot bridge and harness history and authored this PR branch.
